rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: gs_n_iter=800, gs_n_gaussians=384, gs_outer_wall_s=1500, gs_lr_pos=0.003, train_n=2, val_n=2, rationale=iter-3: KNOB=gs_n_gaussians: 512→384 + gs_n_iter 1000→800 + add explicit gs_lr_pos=3e-3. iter-1 (256g/500i) hr=0.0219; iter-2 (512g/1000i) regressed to ~0.
